title: T0 rank-4 QKV LoRA numerical proof

training_method.label: Frozen-base LoRA
training_method.description: Train rank-4 adapters on the combined QKV projection while every dense base parameter remains frozen.

execution_topology.label: Independent worker gradient plus coordinator replay
execution_topology.description: One oracle worker exports complete unnormalized adapter gradients and a separate coordinator model normalizes, clips, and applies them.

memory_profiles.label: CPU-resident FP32
memory_profiles.description: Base, adapters, activations, and optimizer proof state remain in local CPU memory for this numerical fixture.

numerical_profiles.label: Python oracle FP32
numerical_profiles.description: PyTorch FP32 summed-loss backward and coordinator-owned FP32 normalization, clipping, and AdamW.

worker_profiles.label: Local Python 3.11 reference worker
worker_profiles.description: A deterministic local CPU reference used to establish semantics before qualifying browser or native workers.

reproduction.notes: Run from repository commit 5aff4392d3faf0eac740d43c28f57150a7929153, verify SHA256SUMS, repeat to a second output, and compare directories byte-for-byte.
